text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "The Oaks is 2400m. In order to handle a longer distance than our previous targets, I had been training continuously with Daiichi Ruby, but—"
choice_data_list: Alright, let's try running 2400m again today

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ...! Damn it...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She really seems to struggle whenever the distance is increased.
The sharpness she showed in the Fillies' Revue and her stability
in the Oka Sho have completely vanished.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Regarding that matter, I decided to first
hear Daiichi Ruby out
to search for the root cause.
choice_data_list: How are you feeling right now?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: There is no issue.
choice_data_list: Is your footing looking okay, too?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Yes.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Please allow me to speak.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
It's likely just a simple lack of stamina.
We should devote more time to it than ever before.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Going forward, I would appreciate it if you could
propose more training focused on building stamina.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Well then, I shall go...
and run one more lap.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
True, that could also be a factor.
However, if there is another insurmountable wall
standing before her—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Turf, dirt, short distance, long distance...
Umamusume have aptitudes. Though some are all-rounders—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Most of them realize their aptitudes as they race
and continue down that path.
As of now, Daiichi Ruby...

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Phew......

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There is no inherent good or bad to it. However...
Depending on the path you wish to pursue, it may become a wall.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Most of the classic races Daiichi Ruby aims for are medium to long distance... and the “Oaks” is medium distance.
If that is the path she desires, it poses a formidable wall.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Yes.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It's still too early to say for sure at this stage.
First, we'll keep stacking stamina training.
If we can draw any conclusions... it'll be after that.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
First, once this training is over,
I'll assemble a new, efficient routine.
Something that can truly support her—

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
(2400m might be tough for me.
Because it's outside my aptitude—)

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
(Trainer deduced as much.
...And I feel the same way.)

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: However...

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
(There is no question of skipping the Oaks.
As her daughter, avenging Mother's defeat is an absolute must.)

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
(Only by building on all of this, step by step...
can I finally become someone worthy of the "Illustrious Clan.")

text_block_list.name: Young Ruby
text_block_list.text:
..................Then,
what have I been doing this all for...—

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
(They prepared the vessel for me to fulfill my mission.
No matter what happens—)

text_block_list.name: Ruby's Butler
text_block_list.text:
Milady.
I have arrived to escort you.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
I apologize, but
I will be changing the schedule.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: I will be doing some solo practice, so I leave the rest to you.

text_block_list.name: Ruby's Butler
text_block_list.text:
Understood.
Please don't worry about us and focus on your training.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Please.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: —There is no choice but to move forward.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: *pant*...

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: —Huh, was I too early?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I brought a new drink,
but...

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I happened to be passing by and saw you.
I wanted to bring you a little refreshment.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Mind if we train together?
I want to get my body in shape so I can debut soon.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: (If I recall... Miracle-san was frail from birth and is currently making adjustments.)

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ...How are you feeling?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ah, yeah.
I'm okay now!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
It's something I was born with,
so I'll just keep learning to manage it well.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: I see.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Ruby is... running in the Oaks next, right?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"...She's giving it her all
for what's precious to her."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I'm praying
that your wish comes true.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: My wish...

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
...No.
All that exists there—is will.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Yeah.
Right... that's it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (*tap-tap-tap-tap...!*)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The new routine for improving stamina is complete!
It's a masterpiece that I'm confident Daiichi Ruby will be satisfied with.
choice_data_list: (Ruby would probably be... at the gym!)

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Bursting with enthusiasm, I rush in and show Daiichi Ruby
the menu I had just put together.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"Before that.
If you had attached the data via email,
I could have reviewed it immediately."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Fufu... You must be truly proud of this work.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Allow me to take a look.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, days of trial and error
passed by on the road to the Oaks.
